snippet.title: Alpha Nomos - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Alpha Nomos launches October 12 on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

The music went silent and the puppets took over. Cello is fighting her way back through a ruined world to find out what happened to it and to her friends. Every attack, dodge and ability lands on the beat. Stay in time and you tear through the room. Drift off tempo and it turns on you.

We recorded every weapon with live instruments so there's a real player behind every hit. Audio powerups like Reverb, Flanger and Delay reshape how Cello fights and how the track sounds while she does it. Clear an arena, pick your upgrades, push further. Fall and you start the next run sharper.

The free demo is playable now on Steam. Wishlist to catch launch day.

🎵 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2529960/Alpha_Nomos/
🎮 PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gr/concept/10019243
🎮 Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/alpha-nomos/9n5n4xjwq312

Original score by Totem Warriors.

Follow along:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/yneYaXmraM
X: https://x.com/alpha_nomos
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/alphanomos.bsky.social
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alpha_nomos/
Website: https://ribcage.games/

Developed by RibCage Games.
